THNL.description: Dynamic Nodal Load (THNL). Each key is a node number; ITEMS holds one or more time-history nodal load assignments referencing an existing time-history load case (THLCNAME) and function (FUNC_NAME).

ITEMS.description: Array of dynamic nodal load definitions applied to this node.

ID.description: Serial number identifying the item within the node's load list.

THLCNAME.description: Name of an existing Time History Load case (THIS). Must resolve to a defined load case name; an unknown name is rejected at runtime.

FUNC_NAME.description: Name of an existing Time History Function (THFC). The referenced function must be a Force or Moment data type; other function types are rejected at runtime.

DIR.description: Load direction. Case-insensitive; one of X, Y, Z.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to the time-history function.
